text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haah... I gave it everything I 
had in my own way... Even so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I was not able to win... Just like Big 
Sister Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, in her very first Classic-tier 
GⅠ, Mejiro Bright gave a splendid, all-out 
performance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Sister Ryan, I am terribly sorry 
for falling short~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to clear away Sister Ryan's 
sadness somehow, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, sorrow...? Bright, what do you mean 
by that?
choice_data_list: Basically, this is what it means.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told Mejiro Ryan about Mejiro Bright's 
hidden feelings.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's what happened. Thank you, 
Bright. But!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"You don't need to shoulder everything 
yourself. If you take on too much, you'll 
end up just like I did."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Like Sister Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I think the reason I couldn't run 
the Triple Crown races very well was 
because I put way too much pressure on 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So Bright, please run for yourself. That's 
what's best for the Mejiro family, after 
all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright's happiness is the most important 
thing of all. Right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hauwaa... Big sister Ryan~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I... really do adore this so much~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's that about!? Well, I'm glad 
they look up to me, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, let's stay focused for the Nippon 
Derby, too! I'm counting on you, Trainer!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do this together again.
Yeah, let's do this together again.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"The Japanese Derby... I still can't see 
the path I should take..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Should I keep running like this? Or should 
I—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho was a battle fought for 
yesterday. However, the Japan Derby is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like this will be a battle for 
each of their tomorrows.
